_title: Administration settings, register descriptors of apps
_note: What you see: the administration page with every app's register descriptor: absent, behind or current, with the shipped and the installed version, a re-import that skips the version check, the outcome of the last imports with the reason when one failed, and the same list on the command line.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: de beheerpagina met de registerbeschrijving van elke app: ontbreekt, achter of actueel, met de meegeleverde en de geïnstalleerde versie, opnieuw importeren dat de versiecontrole overslaat, de uitkomst van de laatste imports met de reden bij mislukt, en dezelfde lijst op de opdrachtregel.
Beheerinstellingen, registerbeschrijving: Administration settings, register descriptors of apps
alleen voor beheerders, ook op de opdrac: administrators only, also on the command line: occ openregister:registers:inventory
Elke app die een register meelevert, ook: Every app that ships a register, even when the register was never created
Drie standen, apart te filteren. Ontbree: Three states, filtered separately. Absent: the descriptor never landed, part of the app stands still. Behind: the register runs on an older version than the app ships. Current: both versions equal. An app without a descriptor is not listed.
register zaken: Zaken, zaaktypen, taken: register zaken: cases, case types, tasks and decisions
register thema: Tokensets en thema's: register thema: token sets and themes
register verkoop: Leads, organisaties, c: register verkoop: leads, organisations, contact moments
Opnieuw importeren schrijft de beschrijv: Re-import always writes the descriptor, even when the versions are equal. A schema that extends a shipped schema stays and then points at the new base.
Geïmporteerd, ongewijzigd of mislukt, me: Imported, unchanged or failed, with the reason
Vandaag 09:14 door Sanne Visser. Versie: Today 09:14 by Sanne Visser. Version 1.7.2 to 1.9.0: 3 schemas updated, 1 new. The extension besluit-zuiddrecht points at the new base.
Vandaag 09:12 door Sanne Visser. Schema: Today 09:12 by Sanne Visser. Schema groep: property klas refers to a schema that is not in the descriptor. Nothing written; the register is still absent.
Gisteren 16:40 door Sanne Visser. Versie: Yesterday 16:40 by Sanne Visser. Version 2.4.0 written again, no difference from what was there.
Dezelfde lijst op de opdrachtregel, voor: The same list on the command line, for an instance still under repair
